classification.difficultyReason: Read the value at x=3 from the graph by choosing the filled point over the open one. This is one direct reading with a single distinction.

content.prompt: The graph of $y=f(x)$ is shown. Find $f(3)$.

answer.worked:
At $x=3$, the left branch ends at the open point $(3,4)$, so $(3,4)$ is not on the graph. The closed point is $(3,1)$, so
$$f(3)=1.$$
